entries.discoveredDuring: Validation review, before any follow-up held-out inference
entries.defect: The prompt says Export JavaScript function solve(input) without specifying an ES module. The frozen grader loads submission.mjs and requires a named solve export, rejecting otherwise valid CommonJS or default-export implementations.
entries.scopeReason: All three code-generation families share the ambiguous instruction. Debugging families supply an ES-module implementation to repair; the original 1000-prompt corpus explicitly requires ES modules.
handling: Do not alter frozen prompts, graders, configurations, outputs, primary scores or candidate selection.
Report a symmetric exclusion of the complete affected families, never selected individual failures.
Report separate functional module-compatibility observations using unchanged source under isolated ESM/CommonJS loading and the same hidden input/output checks.
The diagnostic cannot replace primary grades or rescue a failed promotion gate. Any claimed improvement must disclose whether the whole-family exclusion changes the conclusion.
